name: @mandate/live-settlement
description: Buildathon Milestone B.5.2: the one explicit Robinhood Chain TESTNET settlement path for the Live AI Lab. A Stock child the real Mandate path verified and reserved is mapped, by a declared testnet settlement fixture, onto a valueless MDEMO BUY on the deployed Phase 7E.3 MandateExecutionGate and handed to the existing robinhood-gate-signer (ADMIT_ATTEMPT, custody, preflight). Dry-run by default; a broadcast needs the operator's exact authorization phrase. The only package in the Live AI Lab with RPC or signing capability.
